Row.Text: [COLOR:ResGoldLabelCS]联机计时指令[ENDCOLOR]
允许公共聊天使用 p+/p++ 加时、p-/p-- 减时，以及 p+++ 临时关闭本回合计时。所有修改仅由房主执行。
[COLOR:ResGoldLabelCS]15 秒计时提醒[ENDCOLOR]
在剩余 15 至 8 秒时播放逐秒提示音。
时代长度优化
调整世界时代持续范围：标准速度下，远古时代40–50回合，古典和中世纪时代50–60回合；联机速度下，远古时代20–25回合，古典和中世纪时代25–30回合。其他时代保持原版。默认开启。
外交栏情报模式
设置右上角外交栏采用个人或团队外交能见度。科技值和文化值始终可见；有限、公开、秘密和绝密能见度依次解锁军力、粮食与生产力、每回合金币与信仰、当前研究的科技与市政。未解锁的情报显示为问号，未接触的玩家仍保持匿名。
FFA 模式
只使用本地玩家对目标玩家的外交能见度。默认选项。
组队模式
使用本队所有玩家对目标玩家的最高外交能见度；队友之间完整共享情报。
全帝国每回合食物盈余
全帝国每回合生产力
每回合金币
每回合信仰
达到绝密外交能见度后显示当前研究项目。
公共聊天发送 p++：本回合每次加时 20 秒，每回合最多 3 次；不足 8 秒时每次加时 24 秒。
公共聊天发送 p--：本回合减时 10 秒，最低 40 秒，每回合限一次。
随机分队
房主将已连接的真人参赛者随机且均衡地分入两队；排除 AI、观察者和空槽。
空位开关
有开放空位时关闭全部空位；没有开放空位时增加一个空位。

Row.Text: [COLOR:ResGoldLabelCS]Multiplayer timer commands[ENDCOLOR]
Enables public-chat p+/p++ time extension, p-/p-- time reduction, and p+++ temporary no-timer commands. Only the host applies changes.
[COLOR:ResGoldLabelCS]15-second warning[ENDCOLOR]
Plays a countdown sound from 15 through 8 seconds remaining.
Era Length Optimization

Adjusts World Era duration ranges: at Standard speed, Ancient lasts 40–50 turns and Classical and Medieval last 50–60; at Online speed, Ancient lasts 20–25 and Classical and Medieval last 25–30. Other eras retain their default ranges. Enabled by default.
Diplomacy Ribbon Intelligence

Sets whether the top-right diplomacy ribbon uses individual or team Diplomatic Visibility. Science and Culture yields are always visible; Limited, Open, Secret, and Top Secret visibility successively reveal Military Strength, Food and Production, Gold and Faith per turn, and current Technology and Civic research. Locked intelligence is shown as a question mark, while unmet players remain anonymous.
FFA Mode
Uses only the local player's Diplomatic Visibility on each target. This is the default.
Team Mode
Uses the highest Diplomatic Visibility that any teammate has on each target; teammates share full intelligence.
Empire-wide Food surplus per turn
Empire-wide Production per turn
Gold per turn
Faith per turn
Current research is shown at Top Secret Diplomatic Visibility.
Send p++ publicly: add 20 seconds per use, up to 3 uses per turn; each use adds 24 seconds below 8 seconds.
Send p-- publicly: subtract 10 seconds once per turn, with a 40-second floor.
Random Teams
Host-only balanced shuffle of connected human participants; excludes AI, observers, and empty slots.
Empty Slots
Close all open empty slots, or add one open slot when none are open.
